Frequently asked questions
Who do I contact about privacy rights or data requests?
privacy@lyric.tech handles access, correction, and deletion requests, as well as any question about the Privacy Policy.
How do I report a security vulnerability?
Lyric runs a responsible disclosure program — report vulnerabilities directly to security@lyric.tech.
How does Lyric govern the use of AI?
Lyric maintains an AI Governance Framework — it sits with the rest of Lyric's security policies in the Security Portal.
Where does Lyric Studio run, and where does data live?
Lyric Studio runs on AWS, inside virtual private clouds. The portal documents the rest — disk encryption, endpoint detection & response, data backups, and a two-hour recovery time objective.
How do I get access to gated reports like SOC 2 Type II?
Request them through the Security Portal — access requests and bulk download are built in, so your whole review packet arrives at once.
